displayIdentity.body: Paul asks about Abraham, contrasts work and trust, then says David pronounces blessing on the person credited righteousness apart from works and quotes forgiven lawlessness and covered sins.
displayIdentity.title: David speaks of forgiveness in Paul’s Abraham argument
